summary: In templates you can loop over groups['name'] to list hosts in a group, and use hostvars[host] to read their facts once a play has contacted those hosts.
questions: How do I list all hosts of a group in a Jinja template?
How do I get the IPs of all db servers inside a template?
Why are hostvars facts empty for other hosts?

answer_card.title: Loop over group hosts in a template
